items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: We met there about 11:00 o'clock on a Friday night... It was just Fillmore, Luther Henderson, Bud Yorkin and all the secretaries, sitting there, just waiting.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, Quincy almost went under. We were at the Tandem Enterprises. that's Bud Yorkin and Norman Lear, you know? We met there about 11:00 o'clock on a Friday night, and Sunday we had to do like wall to wall music. Now, you're involved in copyists, weekends, and you know it's a tough

situation. Quincy was late. We were all there early. It was just Fillmore, Luther Henderson, Bud Yorkin and all the secretaries, sitting there, just waiting. Quincy came in there looking green. When you mentioned that -- when you said the color green, I was worried about Quincy then. Because he's had -- his eyes were almost as baggy as Duke's, you know. It was just a tremendous thing to take on.
